gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Words in Noto Sans Lao Looped settle into solid blocks rather than skylines, each bowl left unfinished on one side. Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Neon-tube letters glowing at one steady line thickness give Righteous its commanding voice. While Righteous grabs attention, Noto Sans Lepcha, a sans-serif with tall, cast-iron stature, carries the reading.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Righteous draws every letter like a laser-etched line of constant width. It handles the showy announcing, while Noto Sans Limbu, a sans-serif with gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters, handles the quiet talking.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Commanding and fun, Righteous gives its curves the same weight as its straight stems. Noto Sans Lisu, a sans-serif whose s curves open generously, sits beneath and lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Fun comes first: Righteous has no calligraphic thinning at all. What stands out most is the gap between that rod-like heading and Noto Sans Lydian, a plain sans with capitals barely taller than lowercase.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Rod-bent and loud, Righteous keeps stroke contrast at essentially zero, its bowls filling the line. And Noto Sans Mahajani, a sans whose lowercase stands tall against its capitals, gives that swagger something modern to stand on.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Each Righteous stroke holds one thickness, like a drawn cable. Beneath it, Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans with a dominant middle zone and generous s bends, supplies a softer texture.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic runs curvy and loose, its lowercase rising near capital height. Righteous, drawn with an unshaded line that never swells, supplies the command, and the pair's best trait is that split between shout and ease.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, its small letters standing almost capital-sized and its curves ending in clear daylight. But shrink Righteous and its toothpaste-like stroke loses the command it has at size.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals brings tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c at any size. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals would settle into running text with an open, easygoing feel, under Righteous's wire-bent strokes.
